news.title: 1 killed in overnight shooting on 15th Street in Atlanta, police say
Man accused of pistol-whipping woman, breaking her nose
news.summary: A man is accused of hitting a woman in the face with an AR pistol, breaking her nose and threatening to kill her in Cobb County, according to an arrest warrant.

news.title: Police investigate deadly shooting in Atlanta neighborhood
news.summary: The Atlanta Police Department had portions of the 1000 block of Barnes Street northwest blocked off with crime scene tape early Sunday.

news.title: Argument turns into overnight shootout in downtown Atlanta
news.summary: The Atlanta Police Department says a fight early on Sunday morning turned into a shooting and one man was hospitalized.

news.title: Man dies after early morning shooting in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: A man died early Sunday morning after being shot in northwest Atlanta, sparking an investigation by city homicide detectives.

news.title: Downtown Atlanta shootout leaves 1 hurt, 1 detained
news.summary: Gunfire erupted along a busy downtown Atlanta corridor early Sunday morning when a dispute between two men escalated into a shootout.

news.title: Atlanta police arrest brothers accused of marijuana trafficking
news.summary: Atlanta police arrested two brothers after a search warrant led to the discovery of about 17 pounds of suspected marijuana, two firearms and more than $6,600 in cash, according to police.

news.title: Man dies after Saturday shooting at Roswell apartment complex
news.summary: A man has died after gunfire erupted at a Roswell apartment complex late Saturday night, prompting a homicide investigation.

news.title: Gunman shoots victim multiple times in downtown Atlanta lot
news.summary: A violent dispute in a downtown Atlanta parking lot left one person wounded early Sunday morning after gunfire erupted outside a vehicle.

news.title: Woman shot husband; drugs, $34K seized, Austell police say
news.summary: A woman is in custody after allegedly shooting her husband early Saturday morning, leading officers to uncover a stash of drugs and over $34,000 in cash inside an Austell home, police said.

news.title: 4 dead, 15 injured in Dallas' Deep Ellum Halloween shootings
news.summary: At least 15 people were injured, and four people are dead after three separate shootings in Dallas' Deep Ellum district early Sunday morning.

news.title: Man dies after Roswell shooting
news.summary: Roswell Police are investigating after officers said a man was shot and killed on Halloween.
